title: When should the operator leave?
hook: An operator may need to wait while its right operand grows.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Convert infix to postfix using precedence, associativity and parentheses on an operator stack.

misconception: Operators should leave the stack as soon as any new operator appears.
objective: Convert infix to postfix using precedence, associativity and parentheses on an operator stack.

claims.text: The operator stack postpones an operator until its operands are complete. Higher precedence operators pop first; equal precedence pops for left associativity but waits for right-associative exponentiation, changing which expression is grouped.
